Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this game! We still have one more match coming up which should be an absolute cracker. It is Oman taking on the United Arab Emirates. That game begins at 1930 local (1530 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!

Gary Wilson, the Ireland skipper feels they did not play their best cricket. Further adds he felt 160 was a par score on this wicket but the chase was a clinical one. States Andy Balbirnie has been doing it for a long time now and he played another excellent knock here. Reckons he is not the ideal T20 player but is a clever batter. Also says Rankin too was brilliant with the ball. Ends by saying they are looking forward to their next game and they want to take it one game at a time and want to give their best.

Aizaz Khan, the Hong Kong skipper, says he feels they were around 15-20 runs short and they lost their way towards the end with the bat. States Kinchit was really good and he has been in the runs lately. Admits they were not able to execute their plans with the ball and they can do a lot better. Mentions they need to assess their plans and come back stronger in the next game. Ends by saying that there is still a long way to go and they need to work harder.

Paul Stirling is down for an interview. Says it is a nice feeling to get the first win and points on the board. States it is important to get off to a good start and says that it helped him. Also informs that it is a very good track to bat on. On being asked about the run out, he says that normally Kevin O'Brien gets in on those kinds of situations he will be much more careful about it.

Earlier in the day, Kinchit Shah was the only batsman for Hong Kong to show some fight as he received no support from the others. The Irish bowlers were up to the mark today, especially Rankin and Adair, who were the pick of the bowlers.

The Hong Kong bowling wasn't that great, to say the least! Yes, the total they were defending was under par but their bowling too was ordinary. They were guilty of bowling too short and wide and with that kind of bowling, something around 150 is impossible to defend.

Ireland have chased this with absolute ease! Right from the start of the second innings, the Hong Kong players knew they were at least 20 runs short but looking at this dominating win, those extra 20 runs wouldn't have mattered. The Irish did not get off to the best of starts as they lost Kevin O'Brien in the first over itself. Andy Balbirnie and Paul Stirling then took Ireland to the brink of victory with an 86-run stand. The opener scored a quickfire half ton to completely corner Hong Kong. Post the fall of his wicket, Balbirnie got good support from Harry Tector and together they took the Irish team over the line with another 50-plus stand.

FOUR! AND THAT WILL BE THE WIN FOR IRELAND! Floated delivery outside off, Balbirnie lofts this over the cover region, beats the fielder at long off to his left and the ball goes into the fence. IRELAND WIN BY 8 WICKETS (16 balls remaining)!
Floated on off, swept away towards square leg for one.
EDGED AND FOUR! Length ball outside off by Christie, Balbirnie looks to push at it but the ball goes fine off the outside edge and it races towards the third man fence.
On the pads of Tector, he flicks this one towards the leg side for one. 50-run stand comes up! Almost there, Ireland.
A low full toss on middle, it's hit right back to the bowler who makes a half-stop in his followthrough.

DROPPED AND FOUR! That has literally gone through the hands of Haroon Arshad! Christie bowls this one short of a length outside off, Tector tries to slog it into the crowd over long on but does not get the desired timing on it. The ball goes to Arshad at long on but it goes straight through his hands and one bounce into the fence behind him.
Tector pulls this one off the inner half of his bat towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball outside off, cut towards deep point for a single.
Length ball on middle and off, Tector looks to push at it but the ball goes off the leading edge towards the third man region for a couple. Ireland need 16 off 24 balls.
Length ball outside off, guided towards the third man region for a single.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
This time Balbirnie flicks it wide of the diving mid-wicket fielder for a couple.
On the pads, Tector flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Balbirnie pushes this one off the back foot towards long on for one.
FOUR! Bad ball, short and  wide outside off and Tector punishes Christie as he cuts this powerfully through point for a boundary.
On the pads of Balbirnie, he flicks it towards the leg side for one.
On the pads of Balbirnie, he plays it uppishly wide of the mid-wicket fielder for a couple.
On middle and off, Tector tries to defend it but the ball goes off the inside edge towards square leg for one.
Another one on the pads, pushed towards long on for one.
Full ball on the pads, pushed towards long on for one.
Kyle Christie is back into the attack now.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shortish ball outside off, Andy cuts it towards deep point for a couple.

FOUR! 50 for Andy Balbirnie! He has not taken a single risk in this innings and this has been a beautifully compiled innings. Full ball on off, Balbirnie gets down on one knee and sweeps this one in front of square leg for a boundary.
Shortish ball on middle and leg, Tector tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Balbirnie rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball towards mid on for one.
FOUR! Bad ball to start off the over by Kinchit! Short ball outside off, Balbirnie rocks back and cuts it through the backward point region for a boundary.
Kinchit Shah is back on!
Length ball outside off, AB plays this one towards the point region for a single.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.

Aizaz bowls a length ball on middle and leg but Tector fails to connect properly on his slog over mid on. The fielder there takes the catch but it is a Free Hit so no harm done and the batters take one instead.
No ball! Overstepping by Aizaz! Length ball on middle and off, Tector defends this one off the back foot towards mid off. The next delivery will be a Free Hit.
AB guides this one towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Pure class from Balbirnie! Aizaz bowls this one full and outside off, he drives this one uppishly through the gap in the cover region for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, pushed towards the man at cover.
On the pads, the batter flicks it straight to the man at fine leg. 5 runs off the over.
Tossed up on off, pushed towards mid on for one.
Full toss on the pads, Tector clips this one in front of square leg for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Flatter one on off, pushed towards deep mid-wicket for a single. Tector is off the mark with this single.
Darted on the pads, pushed towards square leg for a single.
Harry Tector is the new man in.

OUT! Straight to the man! End of Stirling's entertaining knock. He though has done his job. He makes room and smashes this length ball uppishly towards mid off where Singh takes it nicely. A standing ovation as Paul walks back. Ireland need another 58 in 54.
Balbirnie slashes again, this time it goes off the outside edge to the right of the third man fielder for one.
Good stop! Shorter and outside off, Balbirnie cuts it past point. The fielder from third man runs to his right, dives and saves two for his side.
Good length and on off, this is hit hard towards mid off for one.
One more single as another ball is pushed down to long on.
This is on middle, Stirling shows a straight bat and pushes it to long on for one.
Aizaz Khan is back!
Stirling opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for one. Ireland need 64 runs in 60 balls.
This time Balbirnie flicks this one through mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, Stirling pushes this one past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Darts this one just outside off, Stirling pushes it back to the bowler.
On the hips of AB, he pushes this one towards mid on for one.
Shortish on off, Balbirnie cuts it towards point for a couple.
FOUR! This time Stirling creams it all along the ground through the cover region for a boundary.
Balbirnie lofts this one riskily over the cover region for a single.
Floated outside off, pushed towards the cover region.
Floated on the pads, pushed towards long on for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Bad start by Barkat! Short and wide outside off, Balbirnie cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
Waqas Barkat comes into the attack now.
A single to end! This is fuller and on off, it is once again driven through covers this time for two.
Full and on off, this is stroked through covers for one.
Shorter in length and outside off, AB looks to cut but misses.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Bowl short and he will make you pay, bowl full and he would still hit you to the boundary. This is a half volley on off, Stirling stands tall and strokes it past mid off and into the fence. Fifty for Stirling, it has been an excellent innings from him so far. He would want to continue though.
FOUR! Stirling slashes and slashes hard and gets the desired result. Short and wide outside off, Stirling goes after it. He hits it behind point and a boundary results.
Full and floated on leg, pushed towards mid on. The batters take one. 13 runs off the over and the Irish are cruising along.
SIX! POWER! Full and floated on off, Stirling slog sweeps this one down the ground and the ball goes over the long on fielder and into the crowd.
Floated on off, pushed towards mid off for another single.
Full and on the pads, pushed towards mid on for a single.
On the pads of Paul Stirling, he flicks it towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Wide! Down the leg side, Stirling looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Fires this one on the leg pole, Balbirnie pushes this one towards long on for one.

Another good piece of fielding! Very full and on off, Balbirnie strokes it towards cover where Kinchit dives to his left and stops a certain boundary. 7 from the over and an excellent Powerplay for Ireland. They are 48 for 1 after it. Another 106 needed in 84.
One more ball just outside off, Stirling guides it down to third man for one.
Good fielding again! This is very full around off, Stirling jams it out towards cover. The fielder there moves to his left, dives and stops it.
FOUR! Stand and deliver stuff! Shorter and outside off, Stirling stays leg side of the delivery, gets on top of the bounce and hammers it through covers.
This is angled into the batter, Balbirnie looks to flick but  gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the leg side for one.
Looks to bowl a yorker to begin with but ends up bowling a low full toss. AB hits it to mid on.
Nasrulla Rana is on now!
One to end as this is pushed down to long on.

Excellent fielding! Saves three for his side. Stirling makes room and the bowler fires it on the stumps. PS cuts it towards the left of the point fielder. He dives and with one hand makes a half stop. A single taken only.
Fires it on middle, Stirling keeps it out.
Loopy ball on middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
FOUR! Too short and too wide, the bowler pays the price. Raining boundaries here. Short and outside off, Balbirnie goes back and slaps it through covers for a boundary.

A huge, huge shout but nothing! This is fired down the leg side, Balbirnie looks to flick but it goes off something. The keeper takes it and appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Might be off the pad.
Ehsan Khan is into the attack now.
FOUR! Full ball just outside off, Stirling pushes this one off the front foot through extra cover for a boundary.
Fuller one on the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full delivery on middle and leg, pushed towards mid on.
On the pads of Stirling, tucks this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Fantastic stroke! Length ball outside off, Stirling cuts it with panache through the point region for a boundary.
Full ball on the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Second boundary in the over! A good one for Ireland. Another good shot this time by Stirling. Slightly shorter and it is a slower one. Paul waits for it and then cuts it past the diving point fielder for a boundary.
This is fuller and around off, the batter opens the face of the bat and guides it towards point.
Shorter and around off, this is hit down to third man for one.

FOUR! Creamed! Beautiful! A little too full outside off, a half volley actually. Balbirnie leans into it and caresses it through covers. No stopping those. That should release the pressure that was building.
Good length and on off, this is defended.

That could have been pretty close! This is on middle, Stirling pushes it back towards the bowler who gets down and gets a hand to it. The ball goes close past the stumps at the non-striker's end and towards mid off for one.
Aizaz Khan replaces Kinchit Shah after he bowled just one over.

A good nut to end a top over! Length delivery around off, this one pitches and jags back in. Stirling looks to push it on the up but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls on the off side and a run is taken.
One more full ball, Stirling works it to mid-wicket.
Extremely full again, this is worked through square leg for one.
Drags his length back a little, AB defends it off the back foot.
Very full again on middle, Balbirnie works it again towards mid on.
A good delivery to being! A yorker on middle, this is jammed out towards mid on for one.
Andy Balbirnie is the new man in for Ireland. Kyle Christie to bowl from the other end.

OUT! Direct hit and Kevin O'Brien is a goner! He gets a diamond duck! The over which began horribly for Hong Kong has ended brilliantly. A big wicket as Kevin can score very quick runs. This is outside off. Paul Stirling looks to sweep but it goes off the inner half towards backward square leg. The batters go for a run. Rana picks the ball up, a direct hit is needed and he hits the stumps at the striker's end. O'Brien continues running back towards the pavilion as he is well short. End of an action-packed first over, 10 runs and a wicket from it.
One more short ball on off, Stirling pushes it to mid off again.
Flatter and on off, Stirling pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Sloppy, sloppy effort in the field! 10 runs from the first three balls. This is shorter again on middle, this is hit down to long on. The fielder there lets it through and a boundary results.
Stirling misses out there! This is a nothing delivery. Short and on middle, it is asking to be hit. Stirling goes too hard at it and hence, mistimes it towards mid on.
SIX! That is some way of getting of the mark! Wow! This is full and on middle, Stirling needs no sighters. He clears his front leg and tonks it over the bowler's head and over the long on fence.
We are back for the chase! Paul Stirling and Kevin O'Brien are Ireland's openers. The former will be on strike and he will be facing Kinchit Shah. Here we go...
